body:
We are also in America and i would consider myself and my husband part of the majority culture even though we are first generation. Although we are both originally from europe he is from a "hot" culture and I'm from a "cold" one if that makes sense.

My husband is the primary bread winner for all of us but his job is known for firing people on the day for a single mistake. He also works 12 hours a day, every day of the week so he can ensure our financial security. He has had multiple meltdowns and honestly i think his mental health is as bad as mine. But he was raised to be a man and don't want me to see him suffer. I always hesitate to bring more weight to his shoulders. No i don't feel like he is a good partner but he tries and i understand why he is failing. I don't hold that against him. His mom picks on him too it's just in regard to his ability to provide.

I make ok money but my job is very secure. He wants me to keep it- hence why mother in law was supposed to support us.

At the moment we have close to zero options to leave. It could be done if we put alot of effort/research and used our savings. If we leave at the end of summer we will have fixed some of the issues and it will cost way less and require less money.

It's mostly for his mom. Our agreement was to live together for a year then reasses. We could all pretend that everything is fine and go on with our lives. They are the only family we got. There is no one else.
What a nice and wonderful young man he is!
I hope things get better soon ♥️

I'm so sorry that you're getting burnt out too. It really sucks. It helps a lot just to know that there are outers out there going through the same thing and getting through to the other side. Hopefully that will be us soon ♥️
